assessment: Management of configured projects is the maintainer's expected primary task. Another export label alone does not resolve the information-architecture mismatch. This is maintainer feedback, not an unfamiliar reader or visual acceptance; preserve all earlier rounds under their original labels.

confirmedCapabilities.list: projects.mjs lists known preparations and project-row.mjs opens the workspace.
confirmedCapabilities.duplicate: wizard.mjs startFromDuplicate reuses answers in a chosen folder; it does not copy a project folder.
confirmedCapabilities.forget: service.mjs forgetProject and workspace.mjs forget remove only the history entry and explicitly preserve files.
confirmedCapabilities.recovery: project-overview.mjs recovery and service.mjs recover act on the latest recorded operation in a stage, with post-edit guards; not a whole-preparation uninstall.
confirmedCapabilities.renameOrRemoveAll: No whole-preparation removal or project-renaming operation has been verified. Do not promise or implement these as a renderer label change.
